scope: Closed-vocabulary adjudication of the complete phrasing of the V3 synthetic generator, written from the text of each template and not from the generator's family labels, so generated gold can be checked independently. Derives gold for scoring only; never scored as model reasoning, never a runtime planner.
match: exact normalized text of a request-bearing field (case and whitespace insensitive); '{m}' expands over measurement_names. Any other text fails closed.

composition.claims: union of target levels contributed by all rules matched in all request-bearing fields, per axis
composition.analysis_class: the single contributed class; NONE when a composite marker matches, more than one class is contributed, or more than one target level is requested on one axis
composition.unmatched: derivation fails closed; no gold exists

fields.precedence: objective and question are both user requests. A question identical to the objective (after case and whitespace normalization) is not counted twice. Otherwise rules matched in either field are combined, and the composition rules adjudicate conflicts: a question that adds a distinct claim makes the request composite.
fields.analysis_source: objective must match at least one non-composite rule
fields.unadjudicated_claim_content: a field containing a claim trigger outside every matched phrase fails closed; no gold exists
